description:
Order the stops for the shortest trip. The exact best order is proven classically (Held-Karp); with five
stops or fewer the same problem also runs as a QUBO on the CVaR-QAOA quantum simulator, and the signed receipt
shows both. Returns the order, distance, and how much it saves over the order given. Uses straight-line
distance unless you pass distances_km. Stops are not stored.

distances_km.description: Optional n x n road distances or minutes; overrides straight-line distance
distances_km.title: Distances Km

round_trip.description: Return to the start at the end (default true)
round_trip.title: Round Trip

stops.description: 2-12 stops as {name, lat, lon}; the first is the start
stops.title: Stops

name: car_route
title: Privi Car: best route for a list of stops
